ticks.note: `start` while `cancel` is held down. Both charts set `busy` and enter `Job`. `DelayedAbort`'s abort is not checked in the tick `Job` is entered, so it stays in `Job` with `busy` true. `ImmediateAbort`'s abort is checked at once: it fires, sets `busy` back to false and returns to `Idle`. Its `Job` was entered and left in one tick.
`cancel` is still true, and now `DelayedAbort`'s abort may fire too: `Job` is left and `busy` is false. Both charts are in `Idle`.
